features.name: intraday_edge_proximity
features.description: Distance to the nearest edge of the normalized intraday period scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces artificial separation between first and last intraday slots and improves local time-of-day matching.

features.name: regional_price_z_gap_abs
features.description: Absolute gap between clipped standardized NSW and VIC price readings using training-fold mean and scale constants.
features.expected_model_benefit: Places rows with similar cross-region price separation nearer together after robust scaling.

features.name: regional_demand_z_gap_abs
features.description: Absolute gap between standardized NSW and VIC demand readings using training-fold mean and scale constants.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves neighborhood geometry by grouping rows with comparable regional load imbalance.

features.name: price_z_l2_clipped
features.description: Clipped standardized Euclidean magnitude of the two regional price readings.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a robust price-intensity coordinate that limits extreme spike dominance while preserving similarity among price regimes.

features.name: demand_z_l2_clipped
features.description: Clipped standardized Euclidean magnitude of the two regional demand readings.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact load-intensity distance dimension for more consistent neighbor selection across demand levels.

features.name: transfer_z_abs
features.description: Absolute standardized transfer magnitude relative to the training-fold transfer center.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights rows with unusually low or high transfer so distance-based neighborhoods respect flow extremity.

features.name: demand_transfer_balance_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance combining regional demand imbalance and standardized transfer departure from its training-fold center.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups rows with similar load-balance and flow-balance structure, improving local metric relevance.

features.name: unsupervised_centroid_z_l2_clipped
features.description: Clipped standardized Euclidean distance from the training-fold numeric centroid over all seven inputs.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a generic radial coordinate so rows at similar overall operating distance have closer neighborhoods.

features.name: load_price_coupling_similarity
features.description: Similarity score comparing average clipped standardized price intensity with average clipped standardized demand intensity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Brings rows with aligned price and load behavior closer under distance calculations.

features.name: peak_load_window_indicator
features.description: Binary flag for rows in the later-day window with both regional demand readings at or above their training-fold means.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a discrete neighborhood anchor for a common high-load operating regime.

features.name: operating_stress_semantic_score
features.description: Row-level semantic score from 0.0 to 1.0 based on price spikes, high regional demand, transfer extremity, and period context; 0.0 denotes routine conditions and 1.0 denotes severe stress.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a dense semantic coordinate so KNN can place rows with comparable operating stress near each other even when individual fields differ.

features.name: flow_constraint_semantic_score
features.description: Row-level semantic score from 0.0 to 1.0 for whether transfer appears constrained given regional demand imbalance and price separation; 0.0 denotes balanced flow and 1.0 denotes strong constraint.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps KNN align rows with similar inter-region flow regimes even when raw transfer magnitudes differ.
